title: Son and salsa: source percussion rehearsal
scope: Basic tumbao/martillo onset and register adaptations from Rendon pp.16-17, combined with original Compas accompaniment. Not a record transcription or complete source ensemble. Dynamics, tempo, bass, maracas, cascara, bell and conductor changes are Compas choices.
performance: Choose paired 32/23 slots with PRESETS to recall backing and percussion together. On Percussion, OCT−/OCT+ changes the backing and an exact paired TUMBAO TWO or SON PERC preset together on the phrase. Edited/imported grids stay independent (BAND ONLY). Martillo continues through Lift while the authored bell enters; this is a layered arrangement, not a single bongo player switching to hand bell.
